Standalone PDF text extraction using extract

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", "{}")
debugPrint(result.results()[0].metadata())
```
